2610.13663.title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models
2610.13663.paper_summary: Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles---analyst, coder, and recorder~---with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). Across five tasks---spiking classification on MNIST and Digits, and boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) and Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) equations---the agent outperforms the baselines: classification accuracy is 13 percentage points (MNIST) and 6 percentage points (Digits) higher; the error against the analytical single-soliton solution is reduced approximately 2491-fold; the invariant-preservation error drops approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE run with a Gaussian perturbation and by more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations; and the mass drift drops 14-fold for the KS problem with a Gaussian perturbation. The framework thus tunes key components on tasks of different nature without changing its internal structure.
2610.13663.paper_summary_zh: 許多機器學習方法是兩級的：專家選擇一類方法，在這一類中，關鍵組件的選擇至關重要且通常是手動的。本文針對這些組件的自動調整進行探討，並提出一個可轉移至不同性質模型的框架。多代理大型語言模型（LLM）框架有三個角色——分析師、編碼器和記錄器——並配有實驗日誌和沙盒執行環境。與優化整個機器學習腳本或在離散空間中搜索架構的系統不同，該框架在一個開放但語義狹窄的空間中運作：代理僅為指定的組件生成代碼，保持整體網絡結構不變。該方法在兩個方向上得到了驗證：調整具有相關學習的分類脈衝神經網絡，以及使用物理知識神經網絡（PINN）解決高階微分方程。在五個任務中——在MNIST和Digits上進行脈衝分類，以及針對廣義非線性薛丁格方程（GNLSE）和Kuramoto–Sivashinsky（KS）方程的邊界值問題——代理的表現超過了基準：分類準確率比基準高出13個百分點（MNIST）和6個百分點（Digits）；與解析單孤子解的誤差約減少2491倍；在選定的GNLSE運行中，帶有高斯擾動的不變保持誤差約下降325倍，並且在重複初始化的平均值上下降超過100倍；而KS問題在帶有高斯擾動的情況下，質量漂移下降了14倍。因此，該框架在不同性質的任務上調整關鍵組件，而不改變其內部結構。
